description: Daily cost per deployment over a window, for spotting spikes, step changes and sustained growth. Use this before making a recommendation so you can say whether a cost is new, growing, or steady rather than guessing.

configuration.query:
FROM billing_cluster_cost_lookup
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON @timestamp >= conf_start_date AND @timestamp <= conf_end_date
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", @timestamp, NOW()) <= ?days
| EVAL cost = total_chargeable_units * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| STATS cost = SUM(cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day), deployment_name, deployment_id
| SORT day DESC, cost DESC
| LIMIT 200
